docs.purpose: Loads the full details of one saved job for a tradesperson, used when a push notification opens the app straight to that job from closed. It shows the job's address, current construction phase and predicted timing, and only returns anything if that job is actually one the person has bookmarked.
docs.data_story: It reads 5 tables — `lead_views`, `permits`, `trade_forecasts`, `user_profiles` and `entitlements` and writes nothing. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 10 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 2 places: `src/features/admin-flight-center/api/useFlightBoardDetail.ts`, `mobile/src/hooks/useFlightJobDetail.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: The 404 for an unsaved or foreign permit id comes from the WHERE ownership filter, not a separate auth branch, per the file's own header. An optional trade_slug query param must be a member of the account's trade set or the route returns 403. user_profiles/entitlements are read via the shared getCurrentUserContext auth helper, not this handler's own SQL. Called via template literals from both web and mobile. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: AUTH CLASS: 'authenticated' (route-guard.ts:124 + :165-167) AND self-scoped via `lv.user_id = $1` at :66 — an authenticated caller can only read a permit they have themselves saved. Disclosed fields are the same narrow set as the list endpoint (address parts, lifecycle, forecast days) — no cost, income or contact data. // BEHAVIOURAL DIVERGENCE FROM THE LIST ENDPOINT: the list route auto-archives rows whose lifecycle_phase has passed the trade's work_phase (src/app/api/leads/flight-board/route.ts:104-108 using its local PHASE_INDEX at :21-27); THIS route applies no such filter — it has no PHASE_INDEX and no TRADE_TARGET_PHASE import (imports at :15-29). A permit archived out of the list therefore still resolves 200 here. That is arguably correct for the documented cold-boot deep-link use case (header :5-7), but it is an undocumented asymmetry between two endpoints the header says return 'the same shape as a single FlightBoardItem' (types.ts:4-5) — the shape matches; the membership rule does not. // `await (context as …).params` at :78 sits outside the try (:80), so a params rejection escapes to the wrapper and returns the DATABASE_ERROR/INTERNAL_ERROR envelope (with-api-envelope.ts:41-50) rather than this route's own internalError. // ctx.uid bound raw at :100 with no isUuid() guard (contrast src/app/api/leads/detail/[id]/route.ts:66). // CENSUS: census_reads = [lead_views, permits, trade_forecasts, user_profiles, entitlements] — all five VERIFIED. Census listed no writes; the dev-mode user_profiles INSERT (get-user-context.ts:83-89) is one. | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control, revalidate or dynamic export in the file. | Entitlement posture: READ but NOT ENFORCED (src/lib/auth/get-user-context.ts:99-100; ctx.subscription_status never consulted here). | Other guards / classification: Trade-membership check at :94-96. Object-level authorization is the WHERE clause: `lv.user_id = $1 AND lv.permit_num = $2 AND lv.revision_num = $3 AND lv.saved = true AND lv.lead_type = 'permit'` at :66-70 — a permit the caller has not saved returns 404, not 403 (design stated in the file header at :10-13 and matched by the code at :104-105). ctx.uid is bound raw at :100 with no isUuid() normalization. | Locking tests: src/tests/db/flight-board-roundtrip.db.test.ts, src/tests/flight-board-detail.infra.test.ts.
